what: Evidence-backed blockers for public-code papers that were not run in the deep-read dossier. Each entry records the repository, the concrete check, and why no run is reported; supervised reference rows are blocked by scope, zero-shot pipelines by missing artifacts or environment failures.

papers.blocker: Supervised CRIS reference; its official code is a training pipeline and the released checkpoint is a Google Drive link. It is a labelled reference row, not a zero-shot pipeline, so no run was attempted.
papers.checked: repository/README/code inspection or documented download attempt; see deep_read code.findings where inspected

papers.blocker: PSALM is the target same-class zero-shot baseline. Its ~6GB weights were downloaded, but the official detectron2 stack fails to build (MSDeformAttn CUDA ops) and the import path hangs in the transformers Phi module; a PyTorch fallback for MSDeformAttn was written but inference did not complete. Recorded as blocked, not sampled.
